adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, the no-`credentialId` branch (`else { const destinationCalendarCredentials = ...; ... createEvent(c, event) }`) does not pass the destination’s `externalId` into the new `createEvent(credential, calEvent, externalId?)` API. As a result, `CalendarManager.createEvent` will return an `EventResult` with `externalId` unset, and later in `EventManager` the booking reference now uses `externalCalendarId: result.externalId` (replacing the old `evt.destinationCalendar?.externalId`). This is a diff-verifiable regression: bookings created via the no-credentialId path will persist calendar references without `externalCalendarId`. The diff also shows suspicious/broken fallbacks in GoogleCalendarService `updateEvent`/`deleteEvent` (they attempt to derive a calendar id via `find(... externalId === externalCalendarId)` when `externalCalendarId` is falsy), which would compound lifecycle failures when `externalCalendarId` is missing.
